verification.clippy: all-targets all-features and shipping presentation,d3d12; -D warnings

scope_limits: Prepared resource classes/capacities and retained pool owners are the normal-frame contract; resource creation/change, explicit maintenance, resize and shutdown are separate boundaries.
All normal build/compile/prepare/submit/poll/retire/readback/result drops are included; changing valid input/pass composition uses the same ordinary API, not a replay-only fast path.

WSI counts the full normal epoch. Only synchronous winit/Window Rust work is excluded in this isolated fixture without Renderer Rust workers; native/VMA callbacks always cover the whole epoch. Caller and Renderer native/VMA rows may overlap.
Rust counters require the installed application allocator. VMA host callbacks may include requests forwarded to Vulkan; their VMA/driver origin is not distinguished.

Vulkan MemoryAllocate events are successful VMA device-memory notifications; object/resource factories count attempts. D3D12 committed-resource events include implicit heap attempts. Descriptor events count elements or sets. Categories are not additive physical allocation counts.

Callback-external driver/OS/native allocations, D3D12 bootstrap/CPU shader serialization and test-only legacy native factories are unobserved. An independent audit found no missing factory/destructor/reset hooks in ordinary frame/retire/present paths.
Optional native diagnostics are verified in separate strict runs; timings, physical VRAM, another GPU/driver, Linux real GPU, long-duration endurance and real native OOM/device loss are not claimed.
